description: A Metro Rail Maintainer assists in the inspection, preventive maintenance, and basic upkeep of metro rail systems, including Electrical and Mechanical (E and M), track (P-Way), rolling stock, traction power, signalling, telecom and AFC systems, and station infrastructure. The individual supports routine checks, basic servicing, fault identification and reporting, and emergency response activities under supervision to help ensure safe, reliable, and uninterrupted metro operations. The role also involves strict adherence to safety regulations, use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), and compliance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during day and night maintenance activities.
typeOfQualification: General, Upskilling, For ToT, For ToA, Fresh Skilling
